finalText:
Added the 4.2.0 section to `CHANGELOG.md`. Of ~380 commits, only 27 were real fixes or features; everything else was dependency bumps, renames, or internal refactors.

One real behavior change stands out as breaking: expired tokens now return `401` instead of `403` — worth flagging loudly since integrations checking for `403` will break. The other fixes (null-cursor pagination crashes, double-trimmed trailing slashes, empty-allowlist handling, a logged request body, duplicate headers, dropped trace ids, wrong latency units, vague token errors) each landed piecemeal across several modules, so I merged each into one bullet. The one new feature is webhook retry with exponential backoff.

Worth double-checking with whoever owns auth: the 401/403 switch is the one item likely to need a migration note for API consumers.
